adminDescription: Manage staff accounts, registration kiosks, and departments for this hospital.
adminRequestError: The administration request could not be completed.
adminOnly: Administration is available to hospital administrators only.
activationCodeOnce: Copy this code for {{kiosk}} now. For security it is shown only once; if it is lost, choose “New activation code” for this kiosk. Its records are kept.
howItWorksCollection: Approved interview questions collect a patient history. Safety rules flag warning signs for staff review.
howItWorksReview: Patient confirmation, staff review, and the original transcript keep the clinician in control. OPD Saathi does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
aiBriefNote: Written by AI from the patient's own answers. History only, not a diagnosis. Verify with the patient.
consultHintSheet: See the patient's history in English, with their own words alongside.
consultHintEdit: Correct any field — every edit is versioned and audited.
consultHintPdf: Call, start and finish the consultation, then download or print the PDF.
railError: Could not load the patient list. Try refresh.
noPatientsText: Nobody is waiting for a consultation right now. New check-ins appear in the list automatically.
redFlagsExplain: Raised by OPD Saathi's safety rules from what the patient reported. Verify with the patient before acting — this is not a diagnosis.
aiNotVerified: Not verified by staff — compare with the patient's own answers.
workflowCallHint: The token is announced in the waiting room.
workflowConsultHint: Go through the history and red flags with the patient.
workflowCompleteHint: Finish, then download or print the case sheet.
workflowUnknown: Open this patient from the list to see where they are in the workflow.
historyLegend: Each answer shows where it came from. Patient answers are marked by how they gave them (voice, touch or typed); corrections by staff are marked Doctor or Nurse and Staff-verified. Every saved edit creates a new, audited version.
transcriptNote: The patient's own words, exactly as recorded. This record cannot be changed; correct the organized history in Patient history.
notesUnsupported: Examination findings, assessment and plan are not stored in OPD Saathi yet — record them in the hospital's clinical record. To correct what the patient reported, edit it in Patient history.
staffEditsTitle: Staff edits on this case sheet
staffEditsNone: No staff edits yet. Corrections made in Patient history appear here.
versionAudit: Version {{version}} · every saved edit creates a new version and an audit-log entry.

analyticsDoctorEditDetail: Share of case sheets a doctor corrected
analyticsInterviewDetail: From the first to the last kiosk answer
analyticsInterviewEmpty: No kiosk interview in this period.
analyticsTimeSavedHelp: An estimate, not a measurement: the number of visits multiplied by the minutes of history-taking you assume each kiosk interview saves.
baselineHint: Between 0 and {{max}} minutes; the default is {{fallback}}. Only this estimate changes.
baselineStorage: Applies to the whole hospital: every administrator sees the same estimate.
analyticsTrendCaption: Each bar is one day. Days without visits show as zero. Hover, tap or use the arrow keys for exact numbers.
analyticsAboutText: Figures come from daily totals refreshed every 5 minutes and follow the date range and department chosen above. “No data” means there was nothing to measure; 0 is a real zero.
cannotDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account.
staffAccountsHint: Doctors, nurses and administrators who can sign in.
departmentListHint: Departments patients can be sent to.
createUserHint: Add a doctor, nurse or administrator.
createKioskHint: Each kiosk feeds this hospital's single patient queue. A one-time activation code appears after you register it.
createDepartmentHint: Codes and prefixes use capital letters and numbers.
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Share it with the staff member privately.
kioskLabelHint: Use a name staff will recognise, such as its location.
adminSearchKiosks: Search by kiosk name or ID
confirmDeactivateUser: They will be signed out within a few minutes and can't sign in again until an administrator activates the account.
confirmDeactivateOther: You can activate it again at any time.
analyticsNoSheetsEmpty: No case sheets were created in this period.
analyticsDoctorEditHelp: Edited case sheets divided by visits that produced a case sheet. Check-ins abandoned before the history was taken are not counted.
baselineSaveError: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.
analyticsSettingsError: The time-saved setting could not be loaded.
activationCodeHowTo: On the kiosk device, open the setup link once (or type the code). The kiosk then stays signed in by itself.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the code and copy it by hand.
cannotDeleteSelf: You can't delete your own account.
confirmDeleteUsers: They are signed out and removed from this list. Visits and notes they recorded stay in patient history. Their email can be used for a new account.
confirmDeleteKiosks: The device at this kiosk stops working at once and the kiosk is removed from this list. Patients it registered stay in their records. To move a kiosk to a new device instead, use “New activation code”.
confirmDeleteDepartments: It is removed from this list and from staff and kiosk choices. Past visits keep its name. Patients still waiting and staff assigned to it must be moved first.
useAnotherAccountHint: Sign in as someone else in this tab. This account stays signed in on its other tabs.
kioskKindHint: A kiosk screen is set up once with a one-time code. A phone check-in QR is printed, and patients scan it to answer on their own phone.
checkinQrFor: Print this for {{label}}. Patients on the hospital Wi-Fi scan it and answer the questions on their own phone.
checkinQrTest: Test it first: scan it with a phone on the hospital Wi-Fi. The check-in page should open.
checkinQrNoAddress: This PC's Wi-Fi address is not known, so phones cannot open the link yet. Connect to the hospital network and run start-demo.ps1 again.
checkinQrReplaced: New QR ready. Posters with the old QR no longer work.
confirmReplaceQr: Printed posters with the current QR stop working at once. Patients already answering are not affected.
channelPhoneHint: Registered on their own phone: greet and check details at the desk.
